# pybg3's BitKnit2 decoder

`rans.h` and `LICENSE` from https://github.com/eiz/pybg3 (MIT, Copyright (c) 2024 Mackenzie Straight), taken as they are at commit
`3b02e59bb4484c27e49e51ee9d83e8a9d09df4ed` (2024-05-15): `src/rans.h` and `LICENSE`.

Used by tools/game_sky (gr2dump, the sky dome's model maker) to read the game's own Granny `.model` files on the player's PC. Nothing
of the game's is in this repository or in a build.
